SUMMARY: Dawson Butte Open Space MTB with Steve
DESCRIPTION:
Denver Bicycle Touring Club  - DBTC
**11:00 AM MTB P2 T2 Dawson Butte Open Space in Douglas County**. Meet Steve Farley 303-437-5442 (text is best), at the Open Space trailhead for a couple of laps of the trail system. A ride of five miles each lap. The area is mostly forested terrain of rolling hills and open meadow. Respect wildlife as elk, bears, mountain lions and other species call this home. All DBTC riders must sign-in at the start of the ride. Bring a chair because if the weather is cooperatives we can socialize a bit.
Directions to the trailhead, After Castle Rock go south on I25 Exit 174 to 1753 Tomah Road\*.\* at Tomah Rd., go right-west-for 1.5 miles to the Dawson Butte Ranch entrance on the right.
Another option is to go to Sedalia and take Hwy 105- Perry Park RD, south to Tomah Road, approximately 11.0 miles. Take a left on Tomah RD and continue to Dawson Butte Park and the large parking lot.
If rain, snow or cold, no go. Check Meetup for cancelation.
